description: Compose lint, fresh verification assertion, post-verification scope, claim-token recheck, and completion into the streamlined finish service. The model path executes no stored shell command; a separate human-explicit run path previews and runs the ladder. Structural planning failures have exact remediation and release policy, while verification/scope failures retain the claim.

anti_patterns.dont: Auto-release on code, scope, or verification failure
anti_patterns.instead: release only on ADR-approved non-remediable structural planning gates
anti_patterns.why: the agent must retain coordination while correcting its work

anti_patterns.dont: Execute shell commands from a model-callable finish
anti_patterns.instead: require fresh prior verification or a human-explicit run path
anti_patterns.why: database-authored commands are an execution boundary

anti_patterns.dont: Flatten every nonzero result into an opaque tool error
anti_patterns.instead: preserve structured gate payload and exact remediation

preserves.behavior: A failed gate never completes the item
Gate findings use exit 1 and structured payloads; auth remains exit 4
Pi/model finish never runs a stored verification command
Verification commands that modify files are included by human run-finish post-check

verifications.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_agent_service.py tests/test_agent_git.py tests/test_cli_tracker.py tests/test_hosted_backend.py

work_units.evidence: Finish preflight and gate result model implemented in agent.py
work_units.summary: Implement plain finish preflight and exit/gate result model

work_units.evidence: Require-verified freshness assertion with zero subprocess execution implemented
work_units.summary: Implement require-verified freshness assertion with zero subprocess execution

work_units.evidence: Explicit human run_verifications and post-run changed file recomputation implemented
work_units.summary: Implement explicit human run-verifications then post-run changed-file recomputation
